issues.title: Model capacity bottleneck (7B too weak for LP repair)
issues.description: The original Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model could not reliably resolve infeasibility or produce correct objectives. Upgraded to Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (4 GPUs, tp=4) and Qwen3-32B (2 GPUs, tp=2). The 72B model achieved 17/17 pass rate on EasyLP_246 vs 0/6 with 7B, and repaired 3 ComplexLP instances vs 0 with 7B.

issues.title: Insufficient sampling diversity (N=6 too low)
issues.description: With only 6 candidates, marginal instances had low probability of hitting the correct repair. Increased N from 6 to 16 (1 greedy + 16 sampled at temp=0.7), providing ~2.8x more diverse candidates per instance.

issues.title: Single-pass repair misses iterative improvement opportunities
issues.description: Implemented 2-round iterative repair: Round 1 generates N candidates; for still-failed instances, Round 2 re-diagnoses the best LP (or falls back to attempt-0 with a note about the previous failure) and generates N more candidates. This enabled 72B to repair ComplexLP_111 (6/17 in R2) and ComplexLP_86 (1/17 in R2), and Qwen3-32B to repair ComplexLP_211 (1/17 in R2).

issues.title: Round 2 bug: wrong-objective LPs skipped re-diagnosis
issues.description: Initial implementation fed the best wrong-objective LP back into diagnosis, which found it 'optimal' (not infeasible), so no feedback could be generated. Fixed by falling back to the original attempt-0 LP for diagnosis when the previous best LP is not infeasible, and adding a note about the previous failure to the prompt.

summary: Upgraded from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct and Qwen3-32B, increased sampling from N=6 to N=16, and added 2-round iterative repair. Best result: 72B achieved 7/31 (22.58%) repair rate, a 7x improvement over the original 1/31 (3.23%). Three ComplexLP instances were repaired for the first time (ComplexLP_62, ComplexLP_111, ComplexLP_86). Overall pass@1 improved from 58.17% to 58.86%. Qwen3-32B achieved 6/31 (19.35%) with complementary repairs. Union of both models covers 10/31 (32.26%) instances.
